content: {"episode_id":"ep-05015","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"CPT 93229, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring, was medically necessary for this patient, who presented with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness consistent with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0, I48.91).
